notes:
Summary: mid-market product analytics vendor evaluating Redwood for chat + embedding-based search. Started with Hosted API (fast ramp) -> demo went well. Now moving to Dedicated POC for predictable latency and data isolation. Customer is very cost-sensitive and wants a line-item unit economics model before exec sign-off.

Key points / quotes: 
- 'We need predictable per-user costs; bursts during weekly syncs are the pain.' 
- 'If you can show 40–60% cost reduction via batching and caching we can justify Dedicated.'

POC & Evaluation focus: 
- Hosted API demo (2/22): basic integration with product support agent (chat), embedding-based search index. latency ~ 120–250ms p50 on hosted.
- Dedicated POC (target): service 50 qps steady, 500 qps burst; p95 < 350ms; SLA discussion.
- Cost workshop requested: Redwood to run hands-on session covering batching knobs, prefix/KV caching, dynamic batching thresholds, and quantization profile tradeoffs. Team wants a worked example showing token cost before/after with expected latency impact.

Acceptance criteria for POC: 
- 95th percentile latency under target at 50 qps steady using Dedicated config.
- At least one model variant (7B int8 / 13B q4) shows <= 1.5x cost per token improvement over Hosted baseline for their chat workload.
- Successful KMS integration in staging and audit log ingestion to SIEM (stubbed).

Sales notes / pricing convo: 
- Interested in 12–24 month reserved commit if unit economics pan out. 
- Asking for a pricing example: reserved capacity + burst buffer + optimize workshops credits.

Follow-ups: 
- Schedule cost-optimization workshop + invite platform engineering + finance.
- Provide example billing breakdown (token-level + model variant delta).
- Legal: provide data residency language for EU and Canada (they have customers there).
